column1: # Does the CKAN bulk endpoint's offset walk return a STABLE order? Measured 2026-10-20.
# current_package_list_with_resources takes limit and offset and NO sort
# parameter, so an offset walk over it has no ordering guarantee. That matters
# because an unstable offset walk serves one record twice and another NOT AT
# ALL, and the only visible symptom is the duplicate.
# 10 pages of 100 each way, per host: the bulk endpoint as the rows walk it,
# and package_search with sort=id asc. `total` is the portal's own
# package_search count. -1 means the reading could not be made.
# Result: the bulk walk is stable on 9 of the 10 reachable hosts here
# (Kanazawa: 1 duplicate of 319), so this is NOT a beat-wide defect and the 95
# rows were NOT re-pointed wholesale. data.virginia.gov, measured separately,
# IS unstable: 200 duplicates in 2,000 and 1,884 sorted ids the bulk walk never
# returned. That one row is re-pointed and cycles.
# The other finding here is the collection SIZES against 2,000 records a run:
# ckan.govdata.de 169,255, ckan.opendata.swiss 16,117, Tokyo Metro 9,709.
